北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感 -9℃，注意保暖，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels like -9℃. Bundle up and stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪大雾，体感 -1℃。路滑能见度低，小心出行，注意安全。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy and feels like -1℃. Drive safe, visibility is low.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗，体感 2℃。虽无风，早晚温差大，记得加衣！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny, feels like 2℃. No wind, but dress warmly for the cool air.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴好，体感 6℃。早晚凉，别忘了添件外套，注意湿度！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny, feels like 6℃. Nights are cool, grab a jacket and note the humidity!
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 11℃。天气微凉，记得带件薄外套哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 11℃. It's a bit cool, bring a light jacket.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州大雾，体感 -2℃。路滑能见度低，小心出行，别着凉了。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy and feels like -2℃. Drive safe, visibility is low.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有霾，体感 -1℃。注意防护，出门戴口罩，保暖优先哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is hazy and feels like -1℃. Wear a mask, stay warm, and prioritize health.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 4℃。湿度大，出门带伞，注意防潮保暖。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 4℃. High humidity, bring an umbrella, and stay warm.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉起雾，体感 2℃。路滑小心，穿暖和点，别感冒了。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, feels like 2℃. Drive carefully, dress warmly to avoid colds.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 2℃。注意防寒保暖，别忘了多喝热水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feels like 2℃. Stay warm and hydrated with hot drinks.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆起雾，体感 8℃。注意交通安全，早晚温差大，记得加衣。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy, feels like 8℃. Drive safe, dress for temperature changes.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴冷，体感 -14℃。风大天寒，严密保暖防冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but feels like -14℃. It's windy and cold, keep warm to prevent frostbite!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感 -18℃！务必严实保暖，注意防寒防冻！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels like -18℃! Please dress extremely warm to prevent frostbite!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -18℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 4℃。湿度大，早晚凉，记得多穿点。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 4℃. High humidity, mornings/evenings are cool, layer up.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴好，体感 4℃。风力 3级，海边风大，注意防风保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feels like 4℃. With a 3-level wind, it's breezy, stay warm.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾，体感 -4℃。出行注意安全，记得多加衣物保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy, feels like -4℃. Drive safe, dress warmly and layer up.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴冷，体感 -5℃。风大天寒，戴帽子围巾，严防感冒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny but feels like -5℃. It's windy and cold, wear a hat and scarf to prevent colds.
